entries.headline: War Watch relays Mi-8 crash report near Voronezh
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed an OSINTtechnical report that a Russian Mi-8 helicopter crashed during a mission over Voronezh with no survivors, crediting @reagan0965. The post does not independently confirm the crash or provide a casualty count.

entries.headline: Six US Air Force transports reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States, describing the number as above its usual level for that hour. The post did not identify their missions.

entries.headline: Baltic Sea NATO security initiative report shared
entries.summary: War Watch Intel shared a report that Marines would support a NATO security initiative in the Baltic Sea, crediting @reagan0965. The post did not identify the units, deployment schedule or detailed tasks.

entries.headline: SAM582 C-40B sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a Boeing C-40B with callsign SAM582, hex code AE11F8 and registration 02-0042, identifying it with the US Air Force 89th Airlift Wing and crediting reagan0965. The post did not specify its current location or mission.

entries.headline: Five heavy transports and three coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported five US Air Force heavy transport aircraft airborne and three coded US Air Force radio broadcasts heard that day. It placed the latest broadcast about 1.5 hours before the post, without identifying its content or linking it to the flights.

entries.headline: BRTHR22 aircraft sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a sighting with callsign BRTHR22 and hex code AE5848, crediting reagan0965. The post did not identify an aircraft type, location or mission.

entries.headline: Command aircraft and one coded radio broadcast reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported military transport and command aircraft airborne over the continental United States, including nuclear command-and-control aircraft. It also said one coded radio broadcast was heard during that hour, without identifying its content or linking it to the flights.

entries.headline: War Watch shares Middle East carrier deployment report
entries.summary: War Watch Intel shared an AP report that a third aircraft carrier and thousands of troops were heading to the Middle East while Trump weighed new Iran strikes, crediting @reagan0965. The post relays the report rather than independently confirming the movements.

entries.headline: BADGR33 NC-135 sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a Boeing NC-135 with callsign BADGR33, hex code AE01D9 and registration 62-4133, crediting reagan0965. The post did not identify its location or mission.

entries.headline: War Watch shares Putin statement on Kaliningrad
entries.summary: War Watch Intel shared an Insider Paper report that Putin said all weapons were on the agenda if Kaliningrad was attacked, crediting @reagan0965. The post relays a reported statement and does not establish an impending operation.

entries.headline: War Watch shares report of nuclear threat over Kaliningrad
entries.summary: War Watch Intel shared a NewsNation report claiming Russia made a nuclear weapons threat to NATO over Kaliningrad, crediting @timharkness9152. The post relays a news report; it does not provide an independent observation of the threat.

entries.headline: US aircraft, UK activity and jamming near Qatar reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US military transport and surveillance aircraft airborne over the United States, UK activity near MOD Boscombe Down, and jamming experienced by an RAF transport near Qatar. The post did not identify the aircraft missions or the source of the jamming.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert near Kadambuttur
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for an Indian military-operated P-8 near Kadambuttur, India. The alert did not identify a callsign or confirm the flight's destination or mission.

entries.headline: TRDT2 P-8 ground alert near Burton
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported TRDT2, an Australia-registered military P-8, on the ground near Burton, Australia. The alert did not confirm its mission or operational purpose.

entries.headline: UAV15 MQ-9 ground alert near Ridgecrest
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported UAV15, identified as a US-registered MQ-9 Reaper, on the ground near Ridgecrest, California. The post did not confirm a specific mission.

entries.headline: TRDT P-8 ground alert near Burton
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported TRDT, an Australia-registered military P-8, on the ground near Burton, Australia. This is a separate post from the TRDT2 alert; the post does not confirm the aircraft's mission.

entries.headline: New E-6 departure alert at Midwest City
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US-registered E-6 at Midwest City, Oklahoma. The post discusses general communication roles but does not confirm the flight's mission.

entries.headline: DEPOT11 E-2 departure alert at Coronado
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for DEPOT11, identified as a US-registered E-2, near Coronado, United States. The alert reports departure status without confirming its destination or mission.

entries.headline: P-8 ground alert at Oak Harbor
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a US military P-8 on the ground near Oak Harbor, Washington. The alert gives aircraft type and ground status without confirming its mission.

entries.headline: New P-8 departure alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US military-operated P-8 at Orange Park, Florida. The alert does not identify a callsign or confirm its destination or mission.

entries.headline: EAGLE34 E-2 ground alert at Port Hueneme
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported EAGLE34, identified as a US Navy E-2 Hawkeye, on the ground at Port Hueneme, California. The alert gives the aircraft's ground status; it does not confirm a specific mission.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Oak Harbor
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US-registered military P-8 near Oak Harbor, United States. The alert identifies the aircraft type and reported departure status without confirming its mission.

entries.headline: B-1 ground alert near Highworth
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a US-registered B-1 bomber on the ground near Highworth, United Kingdom. Its suggested operational roles are speculative; the alert does not confirm a mission or deployment purpose.

entries.headline: E-6 departure alert at Midwest City
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US military E-6 at Midwest City, Oklahoma. The post describes general strategic communication roles but does not confirm the purpose of this flight.
